title: Per-op help: per-model specificity + the imagery pass
description: MPI-360 shipped the mechanism and generic per-op text. User deferred the two halves that make it teach WELL: per-model advice beyond the one sdxl t2i override, and the media (GIF/video) the dialog already renders but has no files for.
acceptance: help.byModel entries exist wherever prompting genuinely differs - not a full matrix; each entry justified by a measured difference, not a guess
Media files live under assets/help/ and are referenced from the op's help.media; GIF renders via , mp4/webm/mov via the muted looping
The inpaint entry gains a trigger-word list ONLY if a model ships prompt-text routing (Klein MpiTextContains); until then the empty-prompt contract stays the whole story
No op regresses to an empty popup - getOpHelp's info fallback still covers anything unauthored
